ticket.title: Total Hours is displayed inconsistently in Month View

scope: Month View toolbar stats (Scheduled/Total/Absence hours) must aggregate over the displayed month and stay stable regardless of week anchor. Read-only; no writes. Test data on the admin account has no actual hours (Total = 0), so a non-zero total (e.g. 55) cannot be reproduced.

cases.title: Month View June 2026 toolbar stable after week-view navigation

steps.action: Open Attendance, switch to Month view, go back to June 2026
steps.actual: Month view June 2026: 'Scheduled hours: 160, Total hours: 0, Absence hours: 160'

steps.action: Switch to Week view, press Next week twice, switch back to Month view
steps.expected: Month view shows June 2026 with identical toolbar values
steps.actual: After Week view + Next week x2, Month view shows June 2026 again: 'Scheduled hours: 160, Total hours: 0, Absence hours: 160' (unchanged)

observations: October 2026 Month view: Scheduled 168, Total 0, Absence 48 (different from week view 40/0/0 — expected per-scope).
Total hours was 0 in every month checked, so the original 55-vs-0 discrepancy was not exercised with real data.
